thread:
Alex W: Heads up — since the 02:15 deploy we're seeing an uptick in token SLO violations on /generate for convo routes. p99 token-latency jumped ~18% starting ~02:30 UTC. SM occupancy / VRAM graphs look noisy. Anyone else seeing this?

Maria P: Yep saw alerts. Spike lines up with batcher selector oscillations in the traces — kernels flipping a lot. I grabbed a flame and a KV prefetch trace.

Todd C: Pushed a quick heatmap to Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/invite/dash/heatflow?panel=sm_occupancy (filter: route=/generate, shard=us-west-2). Looks like one MIG slice pegged while others idle.

sre-bot: incident INC-1234 created by Maria P — link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-1234

Alex W: Heatmap shows sustained ~98% SM occupancy on slice 3 and thermal creeping up. VRAM usage on that card jumps ~1.7GB at same time window. Timeline matches repeated KV prefetch bursts from long-context sessions (seq_len ~4096).

Maria P: Logs show repeated prefetch calls with identical keys flooding the KVC. Prefetch churn seems to trigger kernel selector to fallback and then re-evaluate -> kernel cache thrash. Suggest either cap prefetch depth or add backpressure to the prefetch path. Snippet: ```python
# naive quick check
if seq_len > 1024:
    prefetch = False
else:
    prefetch = True
```

Todd C: Ran pprof on the canary pod. Kernel selector toggled between fast-attn and fallback every ~200ms as micro-batch shapes changed. That causes repeated kernel compile/cache misses and spikes in SM utilization. A small hysteresis on selector or a TTL on kernel cache would probably stabilize it.

Alex W: Agreed. Low-risk mitigations: increase batcher hold by a few ms to avoid tiny oscillations, extend kernel cache TTL, and throttle kvcache.prefetch for sequences > 2k while we investigate.

Maria P: Applying these to canary now: `batcher.min_hold_ms=8`, `kernel_cache.ttl=30s`, `kvcache.prefetch.window=512`. Starting canary rollout to us-west-2/gpu-pool/slot-7.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started by Maria P -> us-west-2/gpu-pool/slot-7 (commit: ab12cd3).

Todd C: After the canary changes p99 token latency in that shard returned near baseline. SM occupancy flattened, kernel-switch-rate dropped ~85% in the heatmap. VRAM spike frequency reduced but heavy 4k sessions still show transient increases.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed in 6m — status: success (slot-7).

Alex W: Follow-ups: add metric `kernel_switch_events_per_minute` (tagged by route & shard), expose `kvcache.prefetch_churn` and alert when sm_occupancy_skew > 20% across slices. Also add a dashboard panel for "Kernel switch events / min" and a sparkline for prefetch churn.

Maria P: Filed AIM-432 with config/telemetry tasks and test plan: https://board.redwood/infra/AIM-432. I'll schedule shard rollouts tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Todd C: Nice win — thanks for the quick canary work. We'll monitor next 24h for regressions and thermal delta.

Alex W: 👍 keep an eye on the route-level KPIs and the new kernel-switch metric once it's live.
